---
name: build-landmark
description: Build a landmark in an existing district (planner designs, inspector checks the height limit, treasurer pays)
argument-hint: What to build and where, e.g. a bridge named after a disappointing sandwich, in Harbor Row
agent: mayor
---

A citizen proposes a new landmark. Use the description given after the slash command. If it does not say which district, pick the one where it would cause the most delight and the least structural concern.

Run your procedure: record the decision, have the City Planner add the landmark to the district file, have the Building Inspector check it (pay attention to height limits and bridge naming rules), and have the Treasurer pay for it if it was not denied. Report the outcome.
